title: Rotate daily motivational quote at 8am UK time for all users

requirements.text: Update backend quote selection so the quote rotates once per day at 08:00 UK time (Europe/London) for all users (i.e., the same quote is returned to every user for a given UK quote-day), using the existing stored quotes list in backend/main.mo.

quotes: Automatically change everyday at a certain time (8am UK time every day for all users)
They should already be stored on the app. I provided a list of quotes to use previously
The quote isn’t changing it’s just displaying the same one. Can you rotate the quotes between all the ones I previously provided that should be saved?

acceptanceCriteria: Calling getTodaysQuote() before 08:00 UK time returns the quote for the previous UK quote-day; calling it at/after 08:00 UK time returns the next quote in rotation.
Two different authenticated users calling getTodaysQuote() at the same moment receive the same quote string.
The quote index cycles through all entries of the stored quotes list (no fixed single quote).
UK daylight saving time is respected so the changeover remains at 08:00 local UK time year-round (GMT/BST).

requirements.text: Remove the frontend dependency on a user-set time zone for showing the daily quote: the quote banner should load and display the daily quote in the current quote location without showing the time zone prompt.

quotes: Exactly where the quote is currently displayed
Automatically change everyday at a certain time (8am UK time every day for all users)

acceptanceCriteria: The quote banner (DailyMotivationalQuote) no longer shows the "Set your time zone to see your daily motivational quote" prompt as a prerequisite for displaying the quote.
The quote banner successfully displays a quote for an authenticated user even if they have never saved a time zone.
If the quote cannot be loaded, the existing "Quote unavailable" fallback remains shown in English.

requirements.text: Ensure the frontend automatically updates the displayed quote after the 08:00 UK time daily rollover while the app remains open (without requiring a full page refresh).

quotes: Automatically change everyday at a certain time (8am UK time every day for all users)

acceptanceCriteria: If a user has the app open across the 08:00 UK time boundary, the displayed quote updates to the new daily quote shortly after 08:00 UK time without manual refresh.
No excessive polling is introduced (the app should schedule a refetch around the next 08:00 UK time rollover rather than frequently refetching).

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding third-party time zone libraries or external services/APIs.
Implementing per-user quote schedules or per-user time zone-based quote rollovers (the rollover must be 08:00 UK time for all users).
Changing where the quote is displayed (it must remain in the existing quote banner location).
